reviews.text: I have a reactive rescue Pitty who became aggressive towards certain dogs. The rescue introduced me to Sabrina from Shelby Semel Dog Training. Sabrina is fantastic, kind, patient, and focused on improving human and dog quality throughout the training process. I will definitely contact Sabrina when future needs arise.

Doug has worked with me and my Brussels Griffon puppy, Monk, since he was five months old.

His approach is clear and patient, and he has helped me truly understand my dog. The follow-up notes after each session are detailed and incredibly useful, and I regularly refer back to them between sessions.

We’ve made real progress with barking, leash skills, and independence. Highly recommend.

they are a bunch of hucksters that tell you one price to get you in the door and then quadruple the number once it comes time to pay. they’re also snobs who will refuse to pick up the phone or talk to you as a client face to face

I had a great experience with Doug! He was very informative and patient with my many questions since I’m a relatively new dog owner. He was also very thorough and gave me resources / exercises that are manageable. Would definitely recommend him as a trainer!!

We’ve had such a great experience working with Doug! We started training with him to address Banjo’s resource guarding, and we noticed a significant change in Banjo within just the first week.

One of the biggest things Doug helped us realize was that Banjo needed more enrichment in his daily routine. Since making those changes and working on the training Doug recommended, Banjo is noticeably happier and more engaged. It’s been so rewarding to see such a positive change in him.

We’re continuing to work with Doug on Banjo’s resource guarding and separation anxiety, and we’re so happy with the progress we’ve already made. Doug is incredibly knowledgeable and really takes the time to understand the individual dog and what they need. We’re so grateful for his guidance and would absolutely recommend him!

We have an extremely reactive mini schnauzer and after working with a few other trainers with no progress we were completely at a loss. A few people had recommended Shelby Semel so we decided to give it a try and were SO incredibly lucky enough to be matched with Genevieve. I have never worked with a trainer so knowledgable about dog behavior. While other trainers in the past were rigid and just used the same, standard techniques that don't work for highly reactive and anxious dogs, Gen took the time to get to know and understand our dog and provided insight into his behavior. What I appreciated most is that she was always realistic with us and our training sessions/goals never felt idealistic or unattainable. Rather, we truly focused on little steps and management which also completely shifted our own perspective on how we should be engaging with our dog going forward. Gen worked with us through a huge move, the birth of our first child, and the introduction of our nanny and we credit all of our success to her. Even outside of sessions she checks in with texts to see how things are going and genuinely cares about the progress of your dog. If you want someone who will actually take the time to understand your individual circumstances/pet and will truly work with you on creating the right plan with realistic and actionable goals, I can't recommend Gen enough.

Sabrina is incredible. She did a two-week bootcamp with our puppy Max and completely set us up for success. Max isn't our first dog, but honestly the experience has been so different this time, in the best way, and that's all thanks to Sabrina.

She didn't just train Max. She taught us how to work with him and how to keep it going long after the bootcamp ended. That part mattered so much. We finally feel like we know what we're doing.

If you're bringing home a puppy or just want a stronger foundation with your dog, I can't recommend her enough. We're so grateful we found her.

I took Rufles to his first puppy play time and learned a ton. Shelby is fantastic and we're already booked for our next one and  signing up with a trainer. I thought I was doing a great job until I watched them and there is so much more work to be done with Ruffles and frankly- train me! Highly recommend. My pup was safe the whole time and I felt very cozy.

This review is for Laura Folsom at Shelby Semel Training.  My poor rescue dog has been struggling with separation anxiety.  Laura was able to help me get over some initial humps with my little dog Dubu, and in combination with finding the right vet behaviorist, the right medicine combination and Laura's patience my dog Dubu can now stay home alone up to 6 hours.  Separation anxiety is incredibly lonely and daunting.  At first, I was a little wary of the virtual training aspect.  But as someone that can now leave the house for dinner, I can confidently say it works!  Reach out to them!   Hire the trainer, and hire the vet behaviorist!  Your dog will find confidence, and it will let you finally live your life.  My dog is now so happy, and she has finally learned that I will in fact, be right back.

When we brought home our newborn, our first introduction with our 4-year-old Mini Australian Shepherd didn't go as hoped, and we knew we needed guidance quickly. Through our doula's network, we were connected with Shelby, and she turned out to be exactly the right resource at the right time.

Working entirely virtually, Shelby took the time to understand our dog's specific temperament and our situation before building a plan that gave us clear, actionable steps for the re-introduction. She is consultative and thoughtful, and her non-judgmental approach made it easy to be honest about what was and wasn't working.

Her responsiveness has been a real asset. She encourages video check-ins and gets back quickly with specific, practical feedback. Having that kind of accessible support during an already full season of life has made a meaningful difference.

If you're navigating a major life transition with your dog, particularly one involving a new baby, we'd recommend reaching out to Shelby.

I did one session with Doug and I can’t believe what a difference it already made and what a positive experience I had. Doug was kind, professional, active, and so engaging with both me and my puppy. He was so so helpful and patient and I feel so positive and prepared to continue training my puppy going forward will absolutely be doing more sessions with him. Can’t recommend Doug enough!!

I cant say enough good things about this company, and specifically, working with Warren. If you are on the fence about booking a private training package—do it. It is 100% worth it.
Before starting our sessions, I was struggling with an over-excited Golden Retriever puppy. I had reached a point where I was losing hope, but Warren completely helped me regain my patience. His calm, expert approach changed the dynamic almost immediately.
What sets this training apart is how manageable it is. Warren’s training methods are intuitive, and his super detailed recap emails were a total game-changer. They made it incredibly easy to practice on my own between sessions, ensuring that we never lost momentum. Training didn’t feel like a chore, and because Warren’s methods actually work, it was super rewarding.
Ultimately, I feel like I have a totally new dog and an infinitely stronger bond with her. I cannot thank Warren enough for his help. If you want a trainer who truly cares and delivers real results, Warren is your guy!

I am so happy to have met Laura Folsom  from Shelby Semel Dog Training. Her training has allowed us to have a normal life again.
I was sceptical about an online training program but it was my last resort before giving up. I needed to try it even if I didn't believe it would work. How wrong I was. Laura helped step by step to reduce the separation anxiety. We started from nothing to being able to leave Cookie for up to 5 hours. She is now calm and relaxed whenever I go out and I finally have my independence back!

Doug was fantastic to work with. He communicated clearly and consistently made my partner and me feel confident and comfortable while working with our dogs. We can’t thank him enough for his patience, expertise, and effective techniques that have helped our chocolate Labs tremendously.

We’ve been working with Warren Sears from Shelby Semel Dog Training for several months, and it’s been such a great experience from the start. When we first reached out, our dog was struggling with excitement around guests, table manners, and reacting to sounds or animals on TV. Warren took the time to really understand what was going on and came up with a clear, realistic plan for us to follow.

What stands out most is how knowledgeable and patient he is. He never rushes through sessions, and he explains the “why” behind every exercise so we understand what we’re teaching and how it helps. After each lesson, he sends detailed notes and step-by-step guides that are so easy to follow. It’s obvious that he puts a lot of thought into his work and truly cares about setting dogs (and their people!) up for success.

Since starting training, we’ve seen such a big difference. Our dog is calmer, more focused, and handles new situations with a lot more confidence. Even in moments that used to feel stressful, we now know how to respond and help him settle. Warren’s guidance has made a huge impact on our daily life, and we actually enjoy training now because we can see it working.

If you’re looking for a trainer who is skilled, thoughtful, and makes the whole process feel manageable and rewarding, Warren is absolutely the person to go to.

We can’t recommend Doug enough! He is incredibly knowledgeable about all things dog and genuinely cares about his clients. He explains everything in a way that’s easy to understand, follows up with detailed lesson notes, and is always responsive—even between lessons. We’ve worked with him for both private sessions and homeschool, and the experience has been fantastic. Birdie adores him, and so do we! Highly recommend Shelby Semel Dog Training for all of your training needs.

We greatly needed help leash training our puppy and calming down his reactivity to other animals. We filled out the form on the website and were matched with Warren, and it's been nothing short of fantastic!

We sprang for a 1-on-1 training package for our puppy and did five sessions, one every week. The training was very tailored to our specific needs, and Warren provided us with many resources after each session, including a summary of everything we worked on and how to carry the training forward. He was also very communicative and flexible with our busy schedules.

As far as price goes, the value is determined by how much time you dedicate to training between training sessions. We made sure to work on all of the training Warren was giving us so we could progress forward and cover more behaviors. For our puppy, it has been well worth the expense. Within the last few weeks, friends and neighbors who met our puppy before training have commented on how much better behaved he is, and how much calmer and receptive to instruction he seems. Before training, about 90% of my walks with the pup were either him pulling me or me pulling him, with only 10% in that perfect loose-leash, easy-pace walking. Now, it's totally flipped — about 90% of our walks are with a loose leash, and the rest of the time we have the tools we need to break him away from distractions if he happens to pull. So as far as value goes, we've found it was worth every penny!

I highly recommend Shelby Semel Dog Training for its ability to match your needs with a trainer. If you specifically need leash/reactivity training, you can also request Warren specifically on their form.

BUT keep in mind: you get out of it what you put in! The trainer is also training YOU, not just your dog. The more you practice everything they cover in your sessions, the more bang you'll get for your buck, and the faster your pup will show true growth and improvement.

Long overdue but wanted to write this review for Shelby Semel Dog Training!  Shelby is incredible and has an innate understanding of dogs, particularly dogs in New York City!  She comes up with helpful ideas and strategies, empowering both you and your dog!  Highly recommend!

We've worked with Shelby Semel Dog Training for over 1.5 years, since my dog was 4 months old 🥺 We've done just about everything, puppy/adolescent Q&A play sessions (highly recommend!), several group training classes (impulse control, off leash & learn, distracted dog, agility), and most recently private training. We've worked with so many trainers, Sabrina, Warren, Corinne and Shelby.

All of the trainers are great to work with but we have a soft spot for Corinne. She was the first trainer we worked with in group training and did a couple more classes with her. When Shelby gave Corinne as an option for a private trainer (we had two options), I immediately opted for Corinne not just because of how familiar we are with her, but also because she's knowledgeable and cares so much. She's very patient - something you really need when working with dog owners, especially first timers like me! She gave great feedback, especially when I wasn't getting it. My dog Oso loves her so much. He's always so excited to see her. In our private training sessions, we first wanted to work on reactivity and as we continued our sessions, we discovered new skills to work on, things that I never would have thought to work on. Some of the things are fun too! Corinne is great about asking for your goals and thinking of things to work on that are helpful yet match yours and your dog's lifestyles.

I'll stop rambling now, but before I do, I want to say that I highly recommend working with SSDT whether you are a first time dog owner, looking to have fun with your dog, or an owner looking to brush up on some skills or manners.

Would highly recommend! I sought training for Milton, my 4 year old labrador, he was highly leash reactive. Daniel conducted a through assessment and treatment plan.  With Daniel's suggestions Milton's behavior has improved drastically.

Honestly the Worst place! I usually never write reviews but this time I need to do so. I was originally booked with Sabrina who was basically in her trainings and never responded to your emails. After her lack of responses the owner of the program acknowledged (can share the exchanges of emails if needed be) and offered to reimburse some of the sessions. Then she has the audacity to ask that I amend my review. This is shocking! I still have not be reimbursed

We absolutely adore Shelby Semel Training and our incredible trainer, Sabrina! Sabrina has been with us since the second week of bringing home our beloved golden retriever puppy in September 2024, guiding us through every stage of his development. Puppyhood can be challenging anywhere, but especially in New York City, and Sabrina has been our rock throughout it all.

The core philosophy at Shelby Semel is to establish a solid foundation of skills that will support a dog's lifelong growth and success. From crate and potty training to socialization, impulse control, basic obedience, leash manners, and more, Sabrina and the Shelby Semel team have been with us every step of the way. Sabrina's ability to tailor training approaches to match the unique personality of our dog is nothing short of impressive, and she has a true gift for training. Sabrina is exceptionally responsive to any questions or concerns we have, no matter how small or silly they may seem, and we've always felt supported and confident in her guidance. Our pup absolutely adores her, and it's easy to see why--Sabrina connects with dogs on such a deep level.

We also can't recommend their puppy and adolescent play classes enough! These classes have been a game-changer for our social golden retriever. He thrives in the structured and safe environment, eagerly meeting new dogs and developing his social skills.

If you're looking for positive reinforcement training, we wholeheartedly recommend Shelby Semel and Sabrina. Their expertise, care, and dedication have made all the difference in our dog's life and our own.
